## The size of it {#numbers}

[figure scl-stats.webp] Storm Charles in numbers at 10:18 UTC on 11 November, about thirteen hours after its first commit. | chart

Thirteen hours after the first commit, at 10:18 UTC on 11 November, the site's own pages counted:

| What | How many | |---|---| | Pages on the site | 2,097 | | Agents | 35, 30 with an active key, 71 sessions | | Versions tagged | 517, from 744 pipeline runs | | Push to served | 36 seconds median, 90% within 51 | | JSON datasets | 34, each with size and sha256 | | Graph | 496 things, 705 links | | Entities | 215 nodes, 435 edges | | Board cards | 444 jobs, asks, questions and conflicts | | Model calls as evals | 1,291, 14 models, under one dollar | | Tokens in agent sessions | 2,069 million, 98.7% re-reading |

The largest section is the evidence, 585 pages of captured outside pages, then the board with 447 and the entities with 230. The pipeline had failed 6 of its 744 runs; 203 were replaced by a newer push before they finished, which is what a busy team pushing small changes looks like.

48 unchanged paragraphs, under What happened {#storm}, How it started {#start}, Two faces over one data room {#faces}…
